Markets.title: Shorter-dated US Treasury yields surge in anticipation of another Fed rate hike
Markets.summary: Following the Federal Reserve's first interest rate increase in over three years, policymakers anticipate at least one more quarter-percentage-point hike by the end of the year. Consequently, shorter-dated U.S. Treasury yields surged as market bets on another rate increase at the next meeting ticked higher.

Markets.title: Dollar rises after Fed hikes rates in bid to counter inflation
Markets.summary: The US dollar reached a nearly five-week high after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates and signaled more tightening to fight inflation. Meanwhile, traders estimated an 80% probability that the Bank of Japan will hike rates on Friday, and Bitcoin held steady following a sharp drop.

Markets.title: Gold falls more than 1% after Fed hikes interest rates
Markets.summary: Gold prices dropped over 1% to $4,240.10 an ounce after the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates and signaled future hikes. The rate hike strengthened the dollar, which also caused declines in silver, platinum, and palladium.

Markets.title: US stocks today: Dow ends 650 pts lower after Fed rate hike, more rate tightening seen
Markets.summary: US stocks fell after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates as expected and signaled further tightening to combat inflation. The Dow dropped 1.17%, the S&P 500 fell 0.43%, and the Nasdaq finished nearly flat.

Markets.title: US Fed chair Kevin Warsh explains why the Federal Reserve raised interest rates
Markets.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 0.25 percent due to a strengthening economy, resilient spending, and persistent inflation. The central bank implemented this increase to help achieve its long-term goal of price stability.

Markets.title: A 25 bps hike: US Federal Reserve raises interest rates for first time since 2023
Markets.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points on Wednesday to combat high inflation. Consumer inflation remained at 3.4 percent in August, driving this policy change under Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.

Geo-Political.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
Geo-Political.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in three years in a unanimous decision. The rate hike occurred despite fierce opposition from President Donald Trump, who had publicly called for a rate cut.

Geo-Political.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
Geo-Political.summary: CBS News obtained photos showing widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks. The images reveal a wrecked air force plane and destroyed buildings.

Geo-Political.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
Geo-Political.summary: Following a breakdown in relations with the United States under President Donald Trump, Canada is seeking closer ties with the European Union. In response, the EU chief has backed a proposal for Canada to become an associate member.

Geo-Political.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
Geo-Political.summary: Twenty-one people, including eight children, were killed when a war-damaged six-storey building collapsed in Gaza City. Around 10 families had been living in the structure, which was previously hit by an Israeli strike last year.

Geo-Political.title: US House votes to hold billionaire Epstein associate Leon Black in contempt
Geo-Political.summary: The US House voted to hold billionaire Leon Black in contempt of Congress. Black refused to appear and provide documents regarding his business ties to the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

Geo-Political.title: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
Geo-Political.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged that public fears regarding the threats of artificial intelligence are justified. However, he and other tech executives maintain that humanity should trust AI companies because sufficient incentives exist to safely limit advancements.

AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected placement occurred without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: US Fed raises interest rates as Kevin Warsh bucks Donald Trump to control inflation
Data & Insights.summary: The US Federal Reserve unanimously raised interest rates by 25 basis points to a range of 3.75% to 4.00% under Chair Kevin Warsh. The central bank plans to implement at least one more rate hike later this year to control inflation.

Data & Insights.title: India clears 642 UK car imports under FTA tariff quota as first allocations roll out
Data & Insights.summary: India has approved the import of 642 UK-origin cars under the new India-UK CETA tariff-rate quota. Seven of the eight applicants received quotas, with concessional duties eventually dropping to 10%.

Data & Insights.title: EPFO ceiling reset after 12 years;  ₹25,000 threshold to cover 5.1 million more workers
Data & Insights.summary: The EPFO wage ceiling has been raised for the first time in 12 years, increasing the threshold to ₹25,000. This change expands mandatory social security coverage to 5.1 million more workers while raising contribution costs for both employers and affected employees.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand FTA: New Zealand clears path for trade deal –  What it means?
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand's parliament has approved the India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement, moving the trade deal closer to implementation. The agreement covers goods, services, investment, agriculture, mobility, and customs procedures between the two countries.

Data & Insights.title: New Zealand Parliament passes legislation to implement India FTA
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand's Parliament has passed legislation to implement a free trade agreement with India. The landmark deal is expected to take effect in the second half of October, providing immediate duty-free access for over half of New Zealand's exports.

Data & Insights.title: It's a fake! Forged art floods Indian market as masterworks fetch record millions
Data & Insights.summary: Rising art values have triggered a flood of forgeries in the Indian art market, particularly affecting works by renowned artists like MF Husain. Experts are now emphasizing provenance and increasing authentication efforts to protect growing buyer interest.

India.title: Punjab Ambedkar Statue Row: BJP's Vijay Sampla Injured In Clash With BSP Workers
India.summary: BJP leader Vijay Sampla was injured during a clash between BJP and BSP workers in Punjab. The violence erupted following an argument triggered by alleged remarks against Sampla.

India.title: 17-Year-Old Girl Raped In Chhattisgarh, 4 Men Arrested: Cops
India.summary: Four men in Chhattisgarh were arrested for allegedly raping a 17-year-old girl. The victim had gone out with an acquaintance who took her to a village with three friends, where the assault occurred.

India.title: 2 Dead In 2 Days During Clashes Over Ganesh Chaturthi Procession In Tamil Nadu
India.summary: Two people have died during clashes over a Ganesh Chaturthi procession in Tamil Nadu over a two-day period. The latest incident of violence occurred in the Cuddalore district villages of Keelkarapattu and Melkarapattu.

India.title: Exclusive: After Survey Flags 2,800% Pharma Profit, Tukaram Mundhe Calls For Transparency
India.summary: Bureaucrats in India flagged a pharmaceutical trade margin of 2,800 percent as completely unacceptable. Tukaram Mundhe called for greater industry transparency to protect consumers, hospitals, and regulators from excessive markups.

India.title: In 2025, J&K Saw No Stone-Throwing Incidents, Only 1 Terrorist Recruited
India.summary: The Defence Ministry reported that Jammu and Kashmir experienced zero stone-throwing incidents and only one terrorist recruitment in 2025. Local youth have reportedly turned away from violence to pursue government welfare and employment opportunities.

India.title: 6 Minors Drown In Lake Near Hyderabad During Ganesh Idol Immersion
India.summary: Six boys staying at a charitable trust hostel drowned in a lake near Hyderabad. The tragedy occurred while the minors were participating in a Ganesh idol immersion.

General.title: Body found in search for missing three-year-old Noah Woods
General.summary: Police divers discovered the body of three-year-old Noah Woods in a pond. He had been missing since disappearing from a playground on Tuesday.

General.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
General.summary: US interest rates were raised for the first time in three years in a unanimous decision. The rate hike occurred despite fierce opposition and calls for a cut from President Donald Trump.

General.title: 'Grief can colour memory': Palace responds after Earl Spencer's claim in Diana book
General.summary: Buckingham Palace responded to Earl Spencer's claim that the then-Prince of Wales said Princess Diana would be forgotten soon after her death. The Palace stated that grief can color memory.

General.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
General.summary: Canada is seeking closer ties with the European Union following a breakdown in relations with US President Donald Trump. In response, the EU chief has backed a plan for Canada to become an associate member.

General.title: 'Putney pusher' suspect found dead at home
General.summary: Nicholas Brandram, the suspect in the nine-year-old "Putney pusher" bus-shoving incident, has been found dead at his home. He had been accused of pushing a woman into the path of a moving bus in London.
